newsitem.title: JAPAN: JNR says sells Osaka land for 101.0 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: JNR says sells Osaka land for 101.0 bln yen.

text.p: JNR Settlement Corp said on Monday that land located near Osaka's biggest railway station had been bought at auction for 101.0 billion yen by Yodobashi Camera, a discount chainstore.

JNR Settlement Corp said a plot ratio of 1,000 percent may be allowed depending on development plans. The plot ratio is the ratio of floor space of buildings on the site to the size of the plot. The land currently has a plot ratio of 600 percent.
JNR said a building for office use and a building for retail use would be put on the land.
